    "PostToolUse": [{"matcher": "apply_patch", "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "\"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.codex/hooks/ward.sh\" post"}]}],

  }
}

== hook KEEP
#!/bin/sh
# ward-owned: codex-native-hooks v1
# Native event adapter for codex. Usage: ward.sh pre|post, with the event JSON on stdin.
# Hooks may run in a subdirectory, so Ward always checks the project this file is in.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." || exit 2
case "$1" in
  pre)
    [ "keep" = "enable" ] || exit 0
    exec ward hook native --agent codex --guard-approved-specs --event-stdin ;;
  post) exec ward hook native --agent codex --event-stdin ;;
  *) echo "Ward hook wrapper: expected pre or post." >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
